killedBy: capture.mjs: the seams no vitest run can execute (issue #841) asks Chromium not to hint, which is what makes a baseline portable between platforms
why: Hands every text-sized box back to the platform's rasteriser. Linux hints glyph advances through FreeType and macOS does not, so the same bundled face measures differently on each -- bundling the typeface (#864) fixed WHICH face is used, not how it is rasterised. Measured: the gate's first cross-platform run disagreed on 161 values, 106 by 1-2px, with every failing state's evidence screenshot already rendering in Plex. The cruel part is that the machine dropping this line would never see it fail: the flag is a no-op on macOS, so a local check stays green while the required Linux check goes red.
